commitResults.messageTitle: Update README to reflect follow-up commands
commitResults.messageBody:
The README describes follow-up completion and cancellation as
unavailable, although both commands are implemented.

Replace planned-feature wording, add both commands, and explain
that completed and cancelled records remain saved. Clarify how to
find an item's current outstanding index.

The User Guide omits the accepted year range for interaction and
follow-up dates.

Document the four-digit range from 0000 to 9999 and state that early
years are accepted without a warning. Remind users to check the year
before running a command.
Fix DG time-removal test setup

commitResults.messageTitle: Let student edit clear all subjects
commitResults.messageBody:
An empty sub/ was rejected, so a tutor could not remove a student's
last subject without deleting the student and their records. The UG
also implied subjects could be cleared.

Treat a single empty sub/ as "clear all subjects". An empty sub/
mixed with other sub/ values is still rejected.

Fixes #257

commitResults.messageTitle: Document index limit for interaction commands
commitResults.messageBody:
The follow-up sections of the UG say an index larger than 2147483647
gives "Index must be a positive integer.", but the interaction edit
and delete sections do not. Add the same note to both.

Fixes #259

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject student names made of only connectors
commitResults.messageBody:
A name such as s/o or D/O was accepted because the letter check
counted the letters of the connector itself. Run the letter check on
the name with s/o and d/o removed, so a name needs a letter of its own.

Fixes #260

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject parameter prefixes in find keywords
commitResults.messageBody:
find n/Ann treated n/Ann as a literal keyword and showed no students,
with no hint. Other commands take n/NAME, so users are likely to try
it here too. Reject keywords that start with a prefix such as n/,
except the name connectors s/o and d/o, and show the find usage.

Fixes #261
Update README to reflect follow-up commands
Document the accepted date range
Bump MainApp.VERSION for the v1.6 release.

commitResults.messageTitle: Match student add example total to sample data
commitResults.messageBody:
The student add example output showed "Total students: 5", but a
fresh TutorLink starts with 6 sample students, so adding John Tan
gives 7. Update the total and say which starting data it assumes.
